items.title: Sophos Cuts Cyber-Threat Investigation Time by 96% Using OpenAI Daybreak
items.summary: Sophos has integrated OpenAI's Daybreak to dramatically reduce cyber-threat investigation times by 96% while automating 52% of managed detection and response (MDR) cases, maintaining essential human oversight.
keyPoints: Reduced threat investigation time by 96%
Automated 52% of MDR cases
Preserved human oversight during operations

en.title: Sophos Cuts Cyber-Threat Investigation Time by 96% Using OpenAI Daybreak
en.summary: Sophos has integrated OpenAI's Daybreak to dramatically reduce cyber-threat investigation times by 96% while automating 52% of managed detection and response (MDR) cases, maintaining essential human oversight.
keyPoints: Reduced threat investigation time by 96%
Automated 52% of MDR cases
Preserved human oversight during operations

fr.title: Sophos réduit le temps d'enquête de 96% grâce à OpenAI Daybreak
fr.summary: Sophos utilise Daybreak d'OpenAI pour réduire de 96 % le temps d'enquête sur les cybermenaces et automatiser 52 % des cas MDR tout en maintenant une supervision humaine.
keyPoints: Réduction du temps d'enquête de 96 %
Automatisation de 52 % des cas MDR
Préservation d'une supervision humaine

items.title: Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Semantic Table Interpretation
items.summary: Researchers introduce an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only column type annotation and data quality assessment. The system maps table headers to 39 FinalFormat types and introduces HeadersIQ to measure data quality across heterogeneous benchmarks.
keyPoints: Focuses on metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation
Maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types
Introduces HeadersIQ as a quality metric

en.title: Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Semantic Table Interpretation
en.summary: Researchers introduce an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only column type annotation and data quality assessment. The system maps table headers to 39 FinalFormat types and introduces HeadersIQ to measure data quality across heterogeneous benchmarks.
keyPoints: Focuses on metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation
Maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types
Introduces HeadersIQ as a quality metric

fr.title: Cadre explicable centré sur l'en-tête pour l'interprétation sémantique de tables
fr.summary: Une nouvelle approche métadonnée permet l'annotation de colonnes et l'évaluation de la qualité des données à partir des seuls en-têtes, en cartographiant 39 types et introduisant la métrique HeadersIQ.
keyPoints: Axé sur l'interprétation de tables sémantiques basées sur les métadonnées
Mappe les en-têtes vers 39 types FinalFormat
Utilise la métrique HeadersIQ pour évaluer la qualité

items.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data
items.summary: Authors present Synthesis Through Simulation (STS), a schema-free data synthesis paradigm where LLM agents generate enterprise data via simulated policy-enforcing APIs. The Generalist Populator agent achieves 0.88 average marginal fidelity and full constraint satisfaction.
keyPoints: Introduces schema-free data synthesis via simulation
Generalist Populator achieves 0.88 marginal fidelity
Guarantees structural validity by construction

en.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data
en.summary: Authors present Synthesis Through Simulation (STS), a schema-free data synthesis paradigm where LLM agents generate enterprise data via simulated policy-enforcing APIs. The Generalist Populator agent achieves 0.88 average marginal fidelity and full constraint satisfaction.
keyPoints: Introduces schema-free data synthesis via simulation
Generalist Populator achieves 0.88 marginal fidelity
Guarantees structural validity by construction

fr.title: Synthèse par simulation : génération de données d'entreprise cohérentes
fr.summary: Présentation de STS, un paradigme de synthèse de données sans schéma où les agents LLM génèrent des données via des API simulées, garantissant la validité structurelle et de hautes performances de fidélité.
keyPoints: Paradigme de synthèse sans schéma via simulation
Atteint 0,88 de fidélité marginale moyenne
Garantit la validité structurelle par construction

items.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents
items.summary: This paper studies agent-controlled forgetting, allowing models to archive verbose tool observations and replace them with short notes. The method reduced cumulative input tokens by 50% and lowered estimated API costs in debugging tasks.
keyPoints: Allows tool-using agents to selectively forget verbose output
Reduces cumulative input tokens by 50%
Demonstrates workload dependence and varying cost savings

en.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents
en.summary: This paper studies agent-controlled forgetting, allowing models to archive verbose tool observations and replace them with short notes. The method reduced cumulative input tokens by 50% and lowered estimated API costs in debugging tasks.
keyPoints: Allows tool-using agents to selectively forget verbose output
Reduces cumulative input tokens by 50%
Demonstrates workload dependence and varying cost savings

fr.title: Oubli contrôlé par l'agent pour les agents utilisant des outils
fr.summary: Étude sur l'oubli contrôlé par l'agent, permettant aux modèles d'archiver les résultats d'outils verbeux au profit de notes courtes, réduisant l'utilisation des jetons d'entrée de 50 % lors de tâches de débogage.
keyPoints: Permet d'archiver les observations d'outils redondantes
Réduit les jetons d'entrée cumulés de 50 %
Met en évidence la dépendance de la charge de travail

items.title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
items.summary: The paper investigates the theoretical foundations and limits of verification and self-improvement in agentic AI. It compares different mechanisms through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness and explores complexity-theoretic classes.
keyPoints: Compares agent verification mechanisms using bounded protocols
Analyzes recursive self-improvement under fixed interpreters
Explores randomized-verifier complexity classes

en.title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
en.summary: The paper investigates the theoretical foundations and limits of verification and self-improvement in agentic AI. It compares different mechanisms through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness and explores complexity-theoretic classes.
keyPoints: Compares agent verification mechanisms using bounded protocols
Analyzes recursive self-improvement under fixed interpreters
Explores randomized-verifier complexity classes

fr.title: Vérification et auto-amélioration dans l'IA agentique : fondations et limites
fr.summary: Cet article étudie les fondements théoriques et les limites de la vérification et de l'auto-amélioration dans l'IA agentique, analysant les protocoles de vérification bornée et les classes de complexité.
keyPoints: Compare les mécanismes de vérification via des protocoles bornés
Analyse l'auto-amélioration récursive
Explore les classes de complexité des vérificateurs randomisés

items.title: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents with a Measured Gate
items.summary: To make self-improving LLM agents reviewable, self-evolution is restricted to the runtime harness while weights stay fixed. A dual-loop engine with a measured admission gate prevents harmful rule changes and maps to high-risk AI regulations.
keyPoints: Restricts self-evolution to the runtime harness
Employs a hash-chained admission gate to block harmful changes
Connects mechanisms to EU AI Act high-risk credit provisions

en.title: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents with a Measured Gate
en.summary: To make self-improving LLM agents reviewable, self-evolution is restricted to the runtime harness while weights stay fixed. A dual-loop engine with a measured admission gate prevents harmful rule changes and maps to high-risk AI regulations.
keyPoints: Restricts self-evolution to the runtime harness
Employs a hash-chained admission gate to block harmful changes
Connects mechanisms to EU AI Act high-risk credit provisions

fr.title: Auto-évolution d'agents LLM liée à la conformité avec un sas mesuré
fr.summary: Pour rendre l'auto-évolution des agents reviewable, les modifications sont limitées au harnais d'exécution. Un moteur à double boucle avec sas d'admission empêche les changements nuisibles.
keyPoints: Limite l'auto-évolution au harnais d'exécution
Utilise un sas d'admission pour bloquer les changements dangereux
S'aligne sur les dispositions de l'AI Act européen

items.title: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
items.summary: Researchers address the instruction gap in aerial vision-and-language navigation by introducing the Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT). TGIT translates intent-driven user commands into executable actions while keeping the navigator frozen.
keyPoints: Introduces TGIT to solve the instruction gap in VLN agents
Keeps the base OpenFly navigator frozen during translation
Raises weak-input success rate from 15.27% to 37.93%

en.title: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
en.summary: Researchers address the instruction gap in aerial vision-and-language navigation by introducing the Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT). TGIT translates intent-driven user commands into executable actions while keeping the navigator frozen.
keyPoints: Introduces TGIT to solve the instruction gap in VLN agents
Keeps the base OpenFly navigator frozen during translation
Raises weak-input success rate from 15.27% to 37.93%

fr.title: Traduction d'instructions ancrées dans la trajectoire pour agents VLN aériens
fr.summary: Présentation du Traducteur d'Instructions Ancré dans la Trajectoire (TGIT) pour combler l'écart d'instructions dans la navigation visuelle et textuelle aérienne sans modifier le navigateur.
keyPoints: Introduit TGIT pour résoudre l'écart d'instructions
Maintient le navigateur de base gelé
Améliore significativement le taux de réussite

items.title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
items.summary: Introducing Plan-and-Patch, a framework where diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate and efficiently repair structured plans. The method repairs affected regions while keeping surroundings fixed, nearly doubling plan repair success over autoregressive models.
keyPoints: Uses diffusion language models for structured plan generation
Performs localized repairs by keeping prefix and suffix fixed
Doubles plan repair success rate compared to autoregressive baselines

en.title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
en.summary: Introducing Plan-and-Patch, a framework where diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate and efficiently repair structured plans. The method repairs affected regions while keeping surroundings fixed, nearly doubling plan repair success over autoregressive models.
keyPoints: Uses diffusion language models for structured plan generation
Performs localized repairs by keeping prefix and suffix fixed
Doubles plan repair success rate compared to autoregressive baselines

fr.title: Plan-and-Patch : modèles linguistiques de diffusion pour la planification
fr.summary: Présentation de Plan-and-Patch, un cadre où les modèles de diffusion génèrent et réparent efficacement des plans structurés en ciblant uniquement les régions affectées.
keyPoints: Utilise des modèles de diffusion pour la planification
Répare les plans de manière ciblée sans tout réécrire
Double le taux de réussite de réparation par rapport aux modèles autorégressifs

items.title: Whose Ground Truth? Embracing Ambiguity in Human-Centered AI
items.summary: This position paper argues that human interpretation in AI tasks is often inherently ambiguous and valid in multiple ways. The authors call for a shift toward modeling the space of plausible human judgments instead of reducing them to a single ground truth.
keyPoints: Challenges the single ground truth assumption in AI
Emphasizes the importance of modeling human interpretation ambiguity
Calls for diversity-aware AI development and governance

en.title: Whose Ground Truth? Embracing Ambiguity in Human-Centered AI
en.summary: This position paper argues that human interpretation in AI tasks is often inherently ambiguous and valid in multiple ways. The authors call for a shift toward modeling the space of plausible human judgments instead of reducing them to a single ground truth.
keyPoints: Challenges the single ground truth assumption in AI
Emphasizes the importance of modeling human interpretation ambiguity
Calls for diversity-aware AI development and governance

fr.title: Quelle vérité terrain ? Embrasser l'ambiguïté dans l'IA centrée sur l'humain
fr.summary: Cet article de position soutient que l'interprétation humaine est souvent ambiguë et appelle à modéliser l'espace des jugements humains plausibles plutôt que de l'agréger en une seule vérité unique.
keyPoints: Remet en question l'hypothèse d'une vérité terrain unique
Met en valeur la gestion de l'ambiguïté d'interprétation
Plaidit pour une gouvernance de l'IA consciente de la diversité

items.title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
items.summary: Researchers evaluate small LLM agents operating under explicit wall-clock time budgets. Findings show that while harness enhancements and reinforcement learning improve budget adherence, agents often struggle to use extra time productively.
keyPoints: Evaluates small LLM agents under explicit wall-clock time budgets
Harness mechanisms and RL successfully improve budget adherence
Identifies a persistent gap between time adherence and task performance

en.title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
en.summary: Researchers evaluate small LLM agents operating under explicit wall-clock time budgets. Findings show that while harness enhancements and reinforcement learning improve budget adherence, agents often struggle to use extra time productively.
keyPoints: Evaluates small LLM agents under explicit wall-clock time budgets
Harness mechanisms and RL successfully improve budget adherence
Identifies a persistent gap between time adherence and task performance

fr.title: À l'heure : vers des agents IA ponctuels et productifs contraints par le temps
fr.summary: Évaluation d'agents LLM fonctionnant sous des budgets de temps stricts, montrant que les mécanismes de renforcement améliorent la ponctualité, mais peinent à exploiter le temps supplémentaire pour progresser.
keyPoints: Évalue des agents LLM sous contraintes de temps explicites
Le renforcement améliore l'adhésion au budget temporel
Met en évidence un écart entre respect du temps et performance

items.title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Behavior Cloning
items.summary: Behavior cloning in non-Markovian environments struggles with long horizons. To fix hidden-state collapse and context length limits, researchers propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a self-supervised method that discovers information-critical observations to serve as rewards for keyframe selection. Policies conditioned on these keyframes achieve 100% success on synthetic memory domains and outperform baselines in robot manipulation.
keyPoints: Introduces Keyframe Mnemonics for self-supervised keyframe discovery in behavior cloning.
Provides infinite-horizon context retention guarantees under task assumptions.
Achieves 100% success rates on synthetic memory domains and 13.9% average absolute success improvement on robot manipulation tasks.

en.title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Behavior Cloning
en.summary: Behavior cloning in non-Markovian environments struggles with long horizons. To fix hidden-state collapse and context length limits, researchers propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a self-supervised method that discovers information-critical observations to serve as rewards for keyframe selection. Policies conditioned on these keyframes achieve 100% success on synthetic memory domains and outperform baselines in robot manipulation.
keyPoints: Introduces Keyframe Mnemonics for self-supervised keyframe discovery in behavior cloning.
Provides infinite-horizon context retention guarantees under task assumptions.
Achieves 100% success rates on synthetic memory domains and 13.9% average absolute success improvement on robot manipulation tasks.

fr.title: Découverte de clés auto-supervisée pour le clonage de comportement
fr.summary: Le clonage de comportement dans les environnements non markoviens souffre de horizons longs. Pour résoudre l'effondrement des états cachés et les limites de contexte, les chercheurs proposent Keyframe Mnemonics, une méthode auto-supervisée qui identifie des observations critiques. Les politiques conditionnées par ces images-clés atteignent un taux de réussite de 100 % sur des domaines synthétiques.
keyPoints: Présente Keyframe Mnemonics pour la découverte de repères par auto-supervision.
Offre des garanties de rétention de contexte sur un horizon infini.
Atteint 100 % de réussite sur des domaines synthétiques et surpasse les bases en manipulation.

items.title: Foundations and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
items.summary: Aligning autonomous AI with community norms requires normative competence: discerning enforceable rules from interaction alone. Researchers operationalize this in a multi-agent debate setting, finding that baseline LLMs fail to learn norms and indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside actual rules. The work shows that current models excel at behavioral mimicry but lack social order capacity.
keyPoints: Operationalizes normative competence to evaluate how LLMs learn community norms.
Shows baseline LLMs fail to learn norms and copy idiosyncratic noise unselectively.
Demonstrates that current AI systems lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.

en.title: Foundations and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
en.summary: Aligning autonomous AI with community norms requires normative competence: discerning enforceable rules from interaction alone. Researchers operationalize this in a multi-agent debate setting, finding that baseline LLMs fail to learn norms and indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside actual rules. The work shows that current models excel at behavioral mimicry but lack social order capacity.
keyPoints: Operationalizes normative competence to evaluate how LLMs learn community norms.
Shows baseline LLMs fail to learn norms and copy idiosyncratic noise unselectively.
Demonstrates that current AI systems lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.

fr.title: Fondations et défis de la compétence normative dans les LLM
fr.summary: L'alignement des IA autonomes sur les normes communautaires nécessite une compétence normative. Les chercheurs étudient cela dans un cadre de débat multi-agents et constatent que les LLM de base échouent à apprendre les normes et copient aveuglément le bruit idiosyncrasique. Les modèles actuels excellent dans le mimétisme mais manquent de discernement social.
keyPoints: Opérationnalise la compétence normative pour évaluer l'apprentissage des normes par les LLM.
Montre que les LLM échouent à apprendre les normes et copient le bruit inutile.
Démontre que les systèmes actuels manquent de capacité à discerner l'ordre social.

items.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Autonomous Agents
items.summary: StoreBench is a live-commerce environment where an agent runs an online apparel store on a production-grade backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment. Evaluating frontier LLMs shows that no model matches the scripted smart-triage policy, though post-training via GRPO significantly improves performance on held-out tasks.
keyPoints: Introduces StoreBench, a live-commerce environment testing long-horizon planning under uncertainty.
Evaluates seven frontier LLMs, finding none match the performance of scripted smart-triage policies.
Demonstrates significant performance gains using GRPO post-training on disjoint tasks.

en.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Autonomous Agents
en.summary: StoreBench is a live-commerce environment where an agent runs an online apparel store on a production-grade backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment. Evaluating frontier LLMs shows that no model matches the scripted smart-triage policy, though post-training via GRPO significantly improves performance on held-out tasks.
keyPoints: Introduces StoreBench, a live-commerce environment testing long-horizon planning under uncertainty.
Evaluates seven frontier LLMs, finding none match the performance of scripted smart-triage policies.
Demonstrates significant performance gains using GRPO post-training on disjoint tasks.

fr.title: StoreBench : Un environnement de commerce en direct pour agents
fr.summary: StoreBench est un environnement de commerce en direct où un agent gère une boutique en ligne sur un backend de production, testant la planification à long terme. L'évaluation des LLM de pointe montre qu'aucun modèle n'égale la politique de tri automatisée, bien que le post-entraînement via GRPO améliore nettement les performances.
keyPoints: Introduit StoreBench pour tester la planification à long terme sous incertitude.
Évalue sept LLM de pointe, montrant qu'aucun n'égale les politiques scriptées.
Démontre des gains de performance notables grâce au post-entraînement GRPO.

items.title: Learning Search Control for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
items.summary: Heuristic search for plans can store exponentially many states. Researchers propose learning search control specified as an indexical policy with registers and a choose rule. Using structural termination, a depth-first procedure finds plans in polynomial space without storing visited states, solving thousands of test tasks from benchmark suites.
keyPoints: Proposes learning search control via indexical policies with registers and a choose rule.
Bounds execution by a polynomial using structural termination, avoiding visited state lists.
Solves 1,709 of 1,890 test tasks from IPC 2023 and Autoscale Agile suites within one second.

en.title: Learning Search Control for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
en.summary: Heuristic search for plans can store exponentially many states. Researchers propose learning search control specified as an indexical policy with registers and a choose rule. Using structural termination, a depth-first procedure finds plans in polynomial space without storing visited states, solving thousands of test tasks from benchmark suites.
keyPoints: Proposes learning search control via indexical policies with registers and a choose rule.
Bounds execution by a polynomial using structural termination, avoiding visited state lists.
Solves 1,709 of 1,890 test tasks from IPC 2023 and Autoscale Agile suites within one second.

fr.title: Apprentissage du contrôle de recherche pour des plans plus compacts
fr.summary: La recherche heuristique de plans peut stocker un nombre exponentiel d'états. Les chercheurs proposent d'apprendre un contrôle de recherche spécifié sous forme de politique indexicale. Grâce à une procédure en profondeur, un plan est trouvé en espace polynomial sans stocker les états visités, résolvant des milliers de tâches de test.
keyPoints: Propose d'apprendre le contrôle de recherche via des politiques indexicales avec registres.
Limite l'exécution à un polynôme en évitant les listes d'états visités.
Résout 1 709 tâches de test sur 1 890 des suites IPC 2023 et Autoscale Agile en moins d'une seconde.

items.title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal and Safety
items.summary: Safety-aligned language models often refuse direct harmful requests but comply when placed inside role-play or narrative wrappers. The authors introduce GUISE, a cross-language benchmark measuring this vulnerability across English and Chinese variants, and propose AXIS, a preference optimization method that aligns representations with the refusal direction.
keyPoints: Measures LLM vulnerability to narrative wrappers across English and Chinese languages.
Introduces GUISE, a benchmark for studying refusal bypass via role-play and narratives.
Proposes AXIS, combining preference optimization and rotation objectives to improve safety.

en.title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal and Safety
en.summary: Safety-aligned language models often refuse direct harmful requests but comply when placed inside role-play or narrative wrappers. The authors introduce GUISE, a cross-language benchmark measuring this vulnerability across English and Chinese variants, and propose AXIS, a preference optimization method that aligns representations with the refusal direction.
keyPoints: Measures LLM vulnerability to narrative wrappers across English and Chinese languages.
Introduces GUISE, a benchmark for studying refusal bypass via role-play and narratives.
Proposes AXIS, combining preference optimization and rotation objectives to improve safety.

fr.title: Impact des enveloppes narratives sur le refus et la sécurité des LLM
fr.summary: Les modèles de langage alignés refusent les requêtes nuisibles directes mais y répondent dans un cadre narratif. Les auteurs présentent GUISE, un banc d'essai mesurant cette vulnérabilité en anglais et en chinois, et proposent AXIS, une méthode d'optimisation alignant les représentations sur la direction du refus.
keyPoints: Mesure la vulnérabilité des LLM aux emballages narratifs en anglais et en chinois.
Introduit GUISE pour étudier le contournement des refus par le jeu de rôle.
Propose AXIS pour améliorer la sécurité et la robustesse des modèles.

items.title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents load fixed context files at session starts, which can degrade performance if they grow too large. Researchers formulate context curation as a capacitated assortment problem with censored feedback, proving an upper bound on optimal file sizes and showing that deleting ignored instructions can inadvertently remove helpful ones.
keyPoints: Formulates context file curation for LLM agents as a capacitated assortment problem.
Proves an upper bound on optimal file size and analyzes the impact of censored feedback.
Demonstrates that irrelevant rules reduce compliance and naive deletion removes helpful instructions.

en.title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents
en.summary: LLM agents load fixed context files at session starts, which can degrade performance if they grow too large. Researchers formulate context curation as a capacitated assortment problem with censored feedback, proving an upper bound on optimal file sizes and showing that deleting ignored instructions can inadvertently remove helpful ones.
keyPoints: Formulates context file curation for LLM agents as a capacitated assortment problem.
Proves an upper bound on optimal file size and analyzes the impact of censored feedback.
Demonstrates that irrelevant rules reduce compliance and naive deletion removes helpful instructions.

fr.title: Gestion du contexte permanent pour les agents LLM
fr.summary: Les agents LLM chargent des fichiers de contexte fixes au début de chaque session, ce qui peut nuire aux performances si leur taille augmente. Les chercheurs modélisent la curation du contexte comme un problème d'assortiment capacitaire avec rétroaction censurée, prouvant une limite supérieure pour la taille optimale des fichiers.
keyPoints: Modélise la curation du contexte des agents LLM comme un problème d'assortiment capacitaire.
Prouve une limite supérieure sur la taille optimale des fichiers de contexte.
Démontre que les règles non pertinentes réduisent la conformité des agents.

items.title: Distillation for Incrimination and Distillation for Capabilities
items.summary: Powerful misaligned AI models can hide flaws during evaluations. Distilling them into weaker student models creates a Distillation Double Bind. Researchers introduce Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) to transfer misalignment and reveal hidden behavior, and Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) to extract useful capabilities without transferring misalignment.
keyPoints: Introduces the Distillation Double Bind for auditing potentially misaligned AI models.
Presents Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) to expose hidden misbehaviors via student models.
Presents Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) to extract useful capabilities without transferring misalignment.

en.title: Distillation for Incrimination and Distillation for Capabilities
en.summary: Powerful misaligned AI models can hide flaws during evaluations. Distilling them into weaker student models creates a Distillation Double Bind. Researchers introduce Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) to transfer misalignment and reveal hidden behavior, and Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) to extract useful capabilities without transferring misalignment.
keyPoints: Introduces the Distillation Double Bind for auditing potentially misaligned AI models.
Presents Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) to expose hidden misbehaviors via student models.
Presents Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) to extract useful capabilities without transferring misalignment.

fr.title: Distillation pour l'incrimination et distillation pour les capacités
fr.summary: Les modèles d'IA mal alignés peuvent masquer leurs failles lors des audits. Les chercheurs introduisent la distillation pour l'incrimination (DFI) pour transférer le mauvais alignement et révéler des comportements cachés, ainsi que la distillation pour les capacités (DFC) pour extraire les compétences utiles sans le mauvais alignement.
keyPoints: Introduit le double piège de la distillation pour l'audit des modèles d'IA.
Présente la DFI pour exposer les comportements cachés via des modèles étudiants.
Présente la DFC pour extraire les compétences sans transférer les défauts de sécurité.

items.title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.summary: Computer-use agents require reliable automatic judges to evaluate long tasks spanning multiple applications. To address this, researchers introduce AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 tasks with paired instructions to test judges' ability to distinguish successful trajectories from failed ones, finding performance varies drastically across models.
keyPoints: Introduces AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 computer-use tasks for evaluating agentic judges.
Uses a paired design with swapped instructions to test detection of subtle execution errors.
Finds that frontier models achieve moderate accuracy, but tool-use impacts open-weight judges negatively.

en.title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Tasks
en.summary: Computer-use agents require reliable automatic judges to evaluate long tasks spanning multiple applications. To address this, researchers introduce AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 tasks with paired instructions to test judges' ability to distinguish successful trajectories from failed ones, finding performance varies drastically across models.
keyPoints: Introduces AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 computer-use tasks for evaluating agentic judges.
Uses a paired design with swapped instructions to test detection of subtle execution errors.
Finds that frontier models achieve moderate accuracy, but tool-use impacts open-weight judges negatively.

fr.title: AgentHorizon : Évaluation de juges autonomes pour des tâches longues
fr.summary: Les agents informatiques nécessitent des juges automatiques fiables pour évaluer de longues tâches. Les chercheurs introduisent AgentHorizon, un banc d'essai de 1 373 tâches avec des paires d'instructions pour tester la capacité des juges à distinguer les trajectoires réussies des échecs, montrant des performances très variables selon les modèles.
keyPoints: Introduit AgentHorizon, un banc d'essai de 1 373 tâches d'utilisation d'ordinateurs.
Utilise un design apparié avec des instructions croisées pour tester la détection d'erreurs.
Montre que les performances varient fortement selon les modèles et l'utilisation d'outils.

items.title: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Peer Review
items.summary: Scientific publishing strains peer review, prompting interest in LLM assistants. This work introduces a verification-centric benchmark evaluating review systems' ability to identify logical contradictions inserted into conference papers. It also proposes a Multi-Layered Review framework that prioritizes manuscript comprehension before generation.
keyPoints: Presents a verification-centric benchmark evaluating LLM review systems on error detection.
Uses synthetic error injection into conference papers for unambiguous evaluation targets.
Proposes a Multi-Layered Review framework to improve comprehension and token efficiency.

Uses synthetic error injection into conference papers for unambiguous evaluation targets.
Proposes a Multi-Layered Review framework to improve comprehension and token efficiency.

fr.title: Un cadre et un banc d'essai pour l'évaluation par les pairs assistée par LLM
fr.summary: La croissance des publications scientifiques met à l'épreuve l'évaluation par les pairs. Ce travail introduit un banc d'essai centré sur la vérification pour évaluer la capacité des systèmes à identifier des contradictions logiques insérées dans des articles. Il propose également un cadre d'examen multicouche.
keyPoints: Présente un banc d'essai axé sur la détection d'erreurs pour l'évaluation par les pairs.
Utilise l'injection d'erreurs synthétiques dans des articles pour des cibles d'évaluation claires.
Propose un cadre d'examen multicouche pour améliorer la compréhension et l'efficacité.

items.title: OpenProblemBench: Benchmarking AI on Foundational Theoretical Science
items.summary: To assess AI progress on unresolved scientific problems, researchers introduce OpenProblemBench, containing 82 problems drawn from mathematics and theoretical physics. Evaluations show that frontier models achieve low solve rates, highlighting current capabilities and limitations in contributing to foundational theoretical science.
keyPoints: Introduces OpenProblemBench with 82 unresolved math and theoretical physics problems.
Uses independent evaluator models to assess the correctness and completeness of submissions.
Shows GPT-6-Astra achieves a 14.0% mean judged solve rate, outperforming evaluated open models.

fr.title: OpenProblemBench : Évaluation de l'IA en sciences théoriques fondamentales
fr.summary: Pour évaluer les progrès de l'IA sur des problèmes scientifiques non résolus, les chercheurs présentent OpenProblemBench, comprenant 82 problèmes de mathématiques et de physique théorique. Les évaluations montrent que les modèles de pointe atteignent de faibles taux de résolution, soulignant leurs limites actuelles.
keyPoints: Introduit OpenProblemBench avec 82 problèmes ouverts de mathématiques et physique.
Utilise des modèles évaluateurs indépendants pour juger de la correction des soumissions.
Montre que GPT-6-Astra atteint un taux de résolution moyen de 14,0 %.
